purpose: First reproducible learning/export experiment; no architecture search or financial claim
initialization: Xavier uniform matrices, zero bias/shift, unit normalization scale; dedicated seeded CPU generator
shuffle: one full permutation per epoch; dedicated CPU generator seeded seed+1000
selection: lowest validation MAE in original units; strict improvement; earliest epoch wins ties
test_policy: All seeds complete and validation-selected checkpoints sealed before any test scoring; report every seed and both baselines
stopping: Exactly six epochs per seed; numerical failure aborts and is retained; no outcome-dependent extension
limitations: Overlapping forecasts are dependent; no IID significance claim
Local Torch 2.2.2 is an Intel Mac compatibility reference, not a current performance frontier
